title: Professional Email Renewal Dates and Grace Periods
content:
Renewal timing and the grace, suspension and expiry periods of each Professional Email product.

## Renewal setting and charge attempts (all six products)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Renewal on by default | Yes |
| First renewal charge attempt | 7 days before the term end date |
| Retries after a decline | 3 days and 1 day before the term end date |
| Day monthly instalments fall due | the day of month of the term start, or the month's last day when that month has fewer days |

## Grace and retention periods (calendar days)

| Product | Unpaid instalment or renewal may stay unpaid before suspension | Suspended subscription kept before the mail organisation is deleted | Expired subscription can still be renewed, mail read-only |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | 7 | 30 | 15 |
| Harborline Mail Plus | 7 | 30 | 15 |
| Harborline Mail Pro | 7 | 30 | 15 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 10 | 90 | 30 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 10 | 90 | 30 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 10 | 90 | 30 |

## Reading the schedule

- Example (hypothetical dates): for a term ending on 20 March, the first attempt falls on 13 March and the retries on 17 and 19 March.
- Example (hypothetical): an annual term billed monthly that started on the 31st has its instalment due on the 30th in a 30-day month and on the 28th or 29th in February.
